ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left figure is a topographic map of the Iberian Peninsula, marking three places A, B, and C; among them, B is located in the southeastern part of the peninsula, on the side near the Mediterranean Sea. The right figure shows three multi-year average monthly precipitation line graphs, labeled ①, ②, and ③ respectively; among them, line graph ② has the lowest overall precipitation, with precipitation in the summer months close to the minimum value, showing obvious drought. Reasoning: Place B is located near the Mediterranean coast in the southeastern part of the Iberian Peninsula, with a relatively dry climate and relatively little annual precipitation, and the Mediterranean climate feature of little rain in summer is obvious. In the right figure, the one that best matches "little precipitation throughout the year and obvious summer drought" is line graph ②. Therefore, place B corresponds to precipitation line graph ② in the right figure.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图是伊比利亚半岛地形与甲、乙、丙三地位置，右图是①②③三条月降水折线。确定乙在半岛东南部地中海一侧，属于较干燥地区；再看右图，找出全年降水最少且夏季干旱最明显的折线，即②。因此乙对应降水折线②。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左图为伊比利亚半岛地形图，标出了甲、乙、丙三地；其中乙位于半岛东南部、靠近地中海一侧。右图为三条多年平均逐月降水量折线，分别标为①、②、③；其中②折线整体降水量最低，夏季月份降水接近最低值，表现出明显干旱。推理：乙地位于伊比利亚半岛东南部地中海沿岸附近，气候较干燥，年降水量相对少，且地中海气候夏季少雨特征明显。右图中最符合“全年降水少、夏季干旱明显”的是②折线。因此乙地对应右图中的降水折线②。
